newsitem.title: FRANCE: Auberger says had feeling Trichet sees dollar rise.
newsitem.headline: Auberger says had feeling Trichet sees dollar rise.

text.p: French parliamentarian Philippe Auberger said after a hearing with Bank of France governor Jean-Claude Trichet that he had the impression the central bank head expected the dollar to rise further.

"He gave us the impression, though he did not say it as clearly as that, that the dollar would continue to climb and that there would be no damage to the French economy from a rise in the dollar," Auberger, secretary of the parliament's finance committee, told Reuters.
"He did not say it, but he let it be understood that there should be further rises in the dollar," he said.

The dollar was trading around 5.54 francs on Thursday, compared to the rate assumed in France's 1997 budget of 5.07 francs, the exchange rate when the budget was drawn up last August. The dollar has risen 6.9 percent against the franc so far this year.
